KKR Nears $4 Billion Deal for Broadcom Unit (Bloomberg) -- KKR & Co. is nearing a deal worth about $4 billion to buy a software business from Broadcom Inc., according to people with knowledge of the matter.  Broadcom Chief Executive Officer Hock Tan will use the deal to build a bigger foothold in so-called hybrid cloud services, which cater to businesses that store data both in their own facilities and outside server farms.
